name: Mismatched Couple
steps: Tap the portal to swap the husband and wife’s roles. Tap the dirty dishes and have the husband wash them.
Tap the baby crib to make him feed the baby.
Tap the wife’s phone and let the boss catch her slacking.
Tap the book on her desk to trigger a warning.
Drag the folder stack onto her desk.
Tap the desk fan to turn it off.
Tap the wall clock to make her work overtime.
Use the cloth to clean the table stains.
Take ingredients from the fridge and cook the soup.
